title: Enrique's Bold Gambit: Ferran Torres' Surprise Inclusion Ignites PSG's Ligue 1 Opener
summary: Luis Enrique has unveiled Paris Saint-Germain's squad for their Ligue 1 curtain-raiser against Rennes, notably including Ferran Torres for the first time, a move sparking widespread discussion. This decision signals a potential shift in tactical approach as key players like Bradley Barcola and Thilo Mbaye are conspicuously absent.
content:
The air around the Parc des Princes is thick with anticipation as Paris Saint-Germain officially unveils Luis Enrique's maiden Ligue 1 squad, setting the stage for their season opener against Rennes. Amidst the usual roster confirmations, one name stands out, sparking immediate discussion and excitement: Ferran Torres. His unexpected inclusion marks his first call-up, a significant surprise that has quickly become the talking point among fans and pundits alike.

Torres's presence in the squad signals a bold statement from Enrique, hinting at a dynamic and potentially unpredictable tactical approach for the campaign ahead. While the precise role for the Spanish international remains shrouded in pre-match mystery, his versatility across the front line offers Enrique a valuable new dimension. It’s a clear indication that the new era under Enrique promises a blend of established talent and fresh faces ready to make an immediate impact, challenging preconceptions of PSG's attacking setup.

However, the squad announcement isn't just defined by its surprises; it also reveals notable omissions. Bradley Barcola and Thilo Mbaye will be conspicuously absent from the lineup, adding another layer of intrigue to Enrique's selections. These decisions suggest a deeper strategic recalibration, forcing the manager to draw upon the full breadth of his roster and perhaps experiment with new partnerships. The void left by these players, particularly in wide attacking roles, elevates the significance of Torres's call-up and the performances expected from other key figures like Kylian Mbappé and Ousmane Dembélé.

As PSG prepares to kick off their Ligue 1 title defense at Roazhon Park, all eyes will be on how this freshly minted squad, especially with the unexpected injection of Ferran Torres, performs under the watchful gaze of Luis Enrique. This opening fixture against a formidable Rennes side isn't merely a game; it's a litmus test for the new tactical blueprint and an early indicator of PSG's ambitions for the season. The stage is set for a fascinating encounter, promising drama from the very first whistle.
keyTakeaways: Ferran Torres received a surprise first call-up to PSG's squad for the Ligue 1 opener against Rennes.
Key players Bradley Barcola and Thilo Mbaye are notably absent from the squad, prompting tactical adjustments.
The squad selection hints at a bold, potentially experimental approach from new manager Luis Enrique for the season.
author: OneFootball

title: Nvidia Slaps 15%+ Price Hike on AI Servers Amidst Memory Crunch
summary: Nvidia has informed its major clients that the cost of servers equipped with its coveted AI chips will jump by over 15% in many instances. This significant increase is primarily fueled by a global surge in memory prices, threatening to make already colossal AI infrastructure projects even more expensive.
content:
Nvidia, the undisputed king of AI hardware, has delivered a sobering message to its largest clientele: prepare for significantly higher costs. The tech giant has quietly warned that prices for its high-demand AI servers, crucial for powering the world's most advanced artificial intelligence models, are set to climb by more than 15% in many cases.

This substantial increase isn't a unilateral play, but rather a direct ripple effect from the relentless surge in memory prices. The insatiable global demand for advanced memory solutions – particularly High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and next-generation DDR5 – has created a bottleneck in the supply chain. AI workloads are notoriously memory-intensive, and the components required to feed Nvidia's powerful GPUs are becoming increasingly scarce and, consequently, expensive.

For hyperscalers, cloud providers, and enterprise giants building out their AI infrastructure, this translates into an even steeper investment curve. Data center projects, already measured in billions, now face an additional premium, potentially delaying deployments or forcing a re-evaluation of budget allocations. The economic pressure could push tech titans to double down on accelerating their own in-house AI chip development, seeking alternatives to Nvidia's increasingly costly, albeit powerful, ecosystem.

The move underscores a critical vulnerability in the red-hot AI market: while GPU performance is paramount, the supporting components, especially memory, can dictate the pace and cost of innovation. As the world races to harness AI's potential, the memory crunch could act as an unexpected speed bump, reshaping investment strategies and forcing a re-think on the economics of advanced computing at scale. The future of AI might still be bright, but it just got a whole lot more expensive.
keyTakeaways: Nvidia is increasing prices for its AI servers by over 15% for major customers.
The primary driver behind this hike is the escalating cost of high-bandwidth and next-gen memory components.
This surge will make AI infrastructure projects significantly more expensive, potentially accelerating tech giants' in-house chip development efforts.
author: Andrew Sozinov
